ojs_pages.text: Jurnal Pendidikan IPA Indonesia (Indonesian Journal of Science Education) [ P-ISSN 2339-1286 | E-ISSN 2089-4392 ]. Publication Frequency: 4 issues per year (March, June, September, December). APC: Publication fee is IDR 1,500,000. OAI-PMH endpoint available at https://journal.unnes.ac.id/journals/jpii/oai.

Submissions. Online submission system. Authors are invited to submit their manuscripts. Author Guidelines and Submission Preparation Checklist. Publication Ethics and Author Fees: Article Processing Charge (APC) is IDR 1,500,000.
Editorial Team. Editor-in-Chief: Prof. Dr. Parmin Parmin (Universitas Negeri Semarang, Indonesia). Managing Editor: Erna Noor Savitri.
